title: Phase Transition With Rapini-Papoular Surface Anchoring
summary: We analyze the dynamical (in)stability of nematic liquid crystals in the presence of external magnetic fields and Rapini-Papoular surface potential. The P-HAN transition is investigated using a simplified 3D Ericksen-Leslie system. We find the thickness threshold of the P-HAN transition. If the thickness of the nematic layer exceeds this threshold, there is a global-in-time suitable weak solution converging exponentially to a nontrivial equilibrium state as time tends to infinity.
